query_referencia: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seq_veiculo) AS qtd FROM frota_frota WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 AND COALESCE(dsc_marca, '') NOT ILIKE '%DIVERSOS%';
query_gerada: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_veiculos FROM frota_frota WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 AND COALESCE(dsc_marca, '') NOT ILIKE '%DIVERSOS%' AND COALESCE(dsc_num_placa, '') NOT IN ('-1', 'NÃO INFORMADO');
